entries.de337d8e31d0f7dc: The company has set a 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2028' covering the period from the fiscal year ended February 2026 to the fiscal year ending February 2028, and positions 'expanding the number of new customers acquired' and 'improving LTV' as key growth strategies. To expand new customer acquisition, its product planning and marketing team handles product planning that anticipates promotional activities, introduces a 'hit product planning model' into its development process to expand its product lineup, and is building a system to mass-produce high-quality creative content using generative AI, aiming to establish a structure that would enable it to release 10 products a year in the future. To improve LTV, the company aims to raise customer satisfaction and retention rates through improvements that break down the purchase flow into 'application and purchase,' 'product delivery' and 'product use,' and through strengthened CRM.
